offering_description.value: Designs and markets casual footwear, led by lightweight molded clogs and sandals, plus a second casual shoe brand. Sells to consumers and wholesale partners worldwide, with production by third-party contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: molded clogs; sandals; casual shoes; shoe charms and accessories

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers buying casual footwear online and in company stores; B2B: wholesale retailers, department stores, distributors and marketplaces

end_markets.value: casual footwear; fashion apparel and accessories; consumer retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: footwear and accessories sold to consumers directly and to wholesale customers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets footwear made by third-party contract manufacturers, sold to consumers and retailers; retailer: operates own retail stores, outlets and e-commerce sites selling to consumers

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific, with large sales in North America and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: two casual footwear brands, plus shoe charms and accessories sharing customers and channels

distribution_channels.value: online: own brand websites and marketplace storefronts; own locations: company-operated retail stores and outlets; third-party retail: department stores, footwear retailers and wholesale accounts; distributors / dealers: international distributors in some markets
distribution_channels.category: online; own locations; third-party retail; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal consumer product, import tariff and customs, product safety and chemical rules
